en: Namaste 🙏 If this week’s/month’s Chadhava is already done or scheduled, the amount is offered to the temple — it is usually non-refundable. Future debits can be stopped by cancelling the mandate in your UPI app. For a specific case, say “human agent”.
hi: Namaste 🙏 Agar is cycle ki chadhava ho chuki ya schedule hai to rashi mandir ko arpit hoti hai — refund aam taur par nahi hota. Aage ki katauti mandate cancel karke rok sakte hain. Case ke liye “human agent” likhein.
